manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual physical pp225 and 476-478 states that an ItemTransfer BETWEEN/OUT demand takes available source items, splits an unavailable requested quantity into sub-transfers when items later become available, creates transfer backorders with priority over ordinary demand, updates nominal stock when each transfer is actually performed, and does not use lateral support. pp681-683 and 717 describe tracked item-position STSZ/STOHA; installed dictionary gives seven ItemTransfer columns.
controlled_design: Against accepted I02.var03 zero-delay one-unit BETWEEN after h4 IN, change only the h6 DEPOT-01 to BASE-01 ItemTransfer.TFQTY from 1 to 3 and the description; 30 other tables unchanged. Depot begins with one LRU and receives one at h4, so its physical h6 stock is expected to be two before the scheduled request. BASE starts with zero. Item.TRACK=Y, half-hour ITEM collection, seed1, E04 FAST support, all repair/demand routes and 36h horizon remain fixed. This is an IN-then-BETWEEN available-two/request-three probe, not standalone transfer or zero-stock evidence.

pre_run_hypotheses.h6_request: The three-unit h6 request should create an immediate available-stock transfer of up to two physical LRUs and a remaining one-unit transfer backorder; exact event order, quantities, IDs and native reporting must be observed. Converter rejection or different semantics is diagnostic, not success.
pre_run_hypotheses.later_availability: A later source-side return or replenishment may execute the remaining transfer, potentially competing with ordinary demand. Whether, when and which physical item moves, and nominal/on-hand timing at each station, remain conditional pending logs and two station ItemResults ledgers.
pre_run_hypotheses.conservation: Reconcile source stock, in-transit items, target stock, mounted/repair items and any unfinished transfer backorder at each decisive event; do not infer physical conservation solely from station STSZ or aggregate StockTotalResults.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: If there are no valid item-position tables, source/report mismatch, unfinished request at h36, simulator error, or ambiguous ordinary-demand interactions, restrict publication to the supported observation or leave this candidate unpublished.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run audit of accepted parent, installed manual/dictionary pins, frozen child source and TFQTY-only exact table delta
Guarded session-0 SSH native run with host-wide mutex and preserved GUI PID13340
Exact 22 populated authored-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, nonempty native output and sealed raw artifacts
Physical item-ID and transfer-backorder ledger with station-specific native 72-bin ItemResults STSZ/STOHA, later ordinary demand and terminal reconciliation
Author replay, independent read-only replay and final staged audit before publication
limits: Positive result can cover only request-three/available-two shortage after accepted IN at one seed, two stations and one LRU type; it does not establish zero-stock, arbitrary quantities, standalone BETWEEN, positive delay, priority over ordinary demand unless direct contention occurs, lateral support, reorder or procurement.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
